system.description: Rather than armor or even thick clothing, speardancers rely on their shields to deflect arrows or turn aside weapon strikes. Using this Charm, the speardancer incorporates his shield effortlessly into his deadly blade dance--even a shield that would otherwise be too large or cumbersome to use. After activating the Charm, the martial artist does not suffer any mobility penalty for using his shield for one scene. He may use a long spear or poleaxe one-handed as long as he uses a buckler or target shield on his other arm.
